title: Get a permit to export an Australian protected object
what: A person must not export, or attempt to export, an Australian protected object (cultural heritage material on the National Cultural Heritage Control List) except under a permit or certificate under the Act.

laws.title: Protection of Movable Cultural Heritage Act 1986

sources.title: Protection of Movable Cultural Heritage Act 1986
sources.quote: (3) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person exports, or attempts to export, an object; and (b) the object is an Australian protected object; and (c) the person’s conduct referred to in paragraph (a) is otherwise than in accordance with a permit or certificate.

administration.who: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts

sources.title: Protection of Movable Cultural Heritage Act 1986
sources.quote: (6) The Minister must consider the report and: (a) grant to the applicant a permit to export any Class B object that is accessioned into the collection for which the institution is responsible;

sources.title: Protection of Movable Cultural Heritage Act 1986
sources.quote: officer of Customs has the meaning given by subsection 4(1) of the Customs Act 1901.

reach.condition: if it exports Australian protected objects
reach.note: Antique and art dealers and auction houses: the department's examples of protected material (Indigenous art, furniture, stamps and so on) are what these classes trade.

sources.title: Exporting cultural property from Australia
sources.quote: Cultural material may be considered significant for ethnological, historical, literary, artistic, scientific or technological reasons. Examples include Indigenous art, heritage machinery, precious stones, historical documents, furniture, and stamps.

reach.condition: if it ships Australian protected objects abroad

sources.title: Exporting cultural property from Australia
sources.quote: Freight companies could also be prosecuted if they export an Australian protected object even if their only role is transporting the material. Freight companies should confirm that the owner either has a permit or is satisfied that they do not need one.

confidence_note: The duty is quoted from the Act. Which classes trade protected objects is judged from the department's examples; only freight companies are named in official guidance.

assessment.summary: Exporting an Australian protected cultural object needs a permit or certificate under the Act.

marks.reason: A permit is needed before protected objects can be sold to buyers overseas.
